4
5# Calculate SYSTEMATIC DAG 'Presence of Pneumonia Syndrome'
6#
7# Values:
8# - 0 = PNU1 syndrome criteria + antimicrobial criterion not all present
9# - 1 = PNU1 syndrome criteria + antimicrobial criterion all present
10# - NA = Unknown/insufficient data
11calc_sys_pneumonia_0 <- function(
12 # PNU1 Criterion #1: Opacity (calculated fields)
13 d0_pos,
14 dm1_pos,
15 dm2_pos,
16 # Or check individual opacity codes
17 cxr_dm2_opacity_code,
18 ct_dm2_opacity_code,
19 cxr_dm1_opacity_code,
20 ct_dm1_opacity_code,
21 cxr_d0_opacity_code,
22 ct_d0_opacity_code,
23
24 # PNU1 Criterion #2: Fever, WBC, or AMS if elderly
25 hightemp_vsorres,
26 daily_wbc_8a_0,
27 daily_wbc_8a_m1,
28 daily_wbc_8a_m2,
29 age,
30 daily_gcs_8a_0_processed,
31 daily_gcs_8a_m1_processed,
32 daily_gcs_8a_m2_processed,
33 daily_resp_8a_0_code,
34 daily_resp_8a_m1_code,
35 daily_resp_8a_m2_code,
36
37 # PNU1 Criterion #3: Symptoms/signs
38 pna_cdc3,
39 pna_symptoms___1,
40 pna_symptoms___2,
41 pna_symptoms___4,
42 pna_symptoms___5,
43 pna_symptoms___6,
44 pna_symptoms___7,
45 pna_symptoms___8,
46
47 # Antimicrobial criterion
48 daily_antibiotics_0,
49 daily_antiviral_0,
50 mh_antivirals_type___2,
51 mh_antivirals_type___6,
52 mh_antivirals_type___7,
53 mh_antivirals_type___8,
54 mh_antivirals_type___9,
55 mh_antivirals_type___10,
56 mh_antivirals_type___11,
57 mh_antivirals_type___12,
58 mh_antivirals_type___13,
59 mh_antivirals_type___15,
60 has_qualifying_pathogen
61) {
62
63 ## PNU1 Criterion #1: New airspace opacity (unilateral or bilateral)
64 # Check calculated fields first
65 criterion_1_calc <- (d0_pos == 1 | dm1_pos == 1 | dm2_pos == 1)
66
67 # Also check individual opacity codes (code "2" = bilateral, code "1" = unilateral)
68 criterion_1_raw <- (
69 cxr_dm2_opacity_code == "1" |
70 ct_dm2_opacity_code == "1" |
71 cxr_dm1_opacity_code == "1" |
72 ct_dm1_opacity_code == "1" |
73 cxr_d0_opacity_code == "1" |
74 ct_d0_opacity_code == "1"
75 )
76
77 # Criterion #1 met if either calculated or raw check is true
78 criterion_1 <- (criterion_1_calc | criterion_1_raw)
79
80 ## PNU1 Criterion #2: fever, WBC, or (if elderly) AMS
81 # Sub-criterion 2a: Fever > 38°C
82 criterion_2a <- (!is.na(hightemp_vsorres) & hightemp_vsorres > 38)
83
84 # Sub-criterion 2b: High WBC >= 12
85 criterion_2b <- (
86 (!is.na(daily_wbc_8a_0) & daily_wbc_8a_0 >= 12) |
87 (!is.na(daily_wbc_8a_m1) & daily_wbc_8a_m1 >= 12) |
88 (!is.na(daily_wbc_8a_m2) & daily_wbc_8a_m2 >= 12)
89 )
90
91 # Sub-criterion 2c: Low WBC <= 4
92 criterion_2c <- (
93 (!is.na(daily_wbc_8a_0) & daily_wbc_8a_0 <= 4) |
94 (!is.na(daily_wbc_8a_m1) & daily_wbc_8a_m1 <= 4) |
95 (!is.na(daily_wbc_8a_m2) & daily_wbc_8a_m2 <= 4)
96 )
97
98 # Sub-criterion 2d: Elderly (>=70) with AMS
99 # AMS = GCS < 15 AND not on IMV (resp codes 1 or 3)
100 # GCS values have already been processed to treat T values as 15
101 ams_day_0 <- (
102 !is.na(daily_gcs_8a_0_processed) &
103 !is.na(daily_resp_8a_0_code) &
104 as.numeric(daily_gcs_8a_0_processed) < 15 &
105 !(daily_resp_8a_0_code %in% c("1", "3"))
106 )
107
108 ams_day_m1 <- (
109 !is.na(daily_gcs_8a_m1_processed) &
110 !is.na(daily_resp_8a_m1_code) &
111 as.numeric(daily_gcs_8a_m1_processed) < 15 &
112 !(daily_resp_8a_m1_code %in% c("1", "3"))
113 )
114
115 ams_day_m2 <- (
116 !is.na(daily_gcs_8a_m2_processed) &
117 !is.na(daily_resp_8a_m2_code) &
118 as.numeric(daily_gcs_8a_m2_processed) < 15 &
119 !(daily_resp_8a_m2_code %in% c("1", "3"))
120 )
121
122 criterion_2d <- (
123 !is.na(age) &
124 age >= 70 &
125 (ams_day_0 | ams_day_m1 | ams_day_m2)
126 )
127
128 # Criterion #2 met if any sub-criterion is met
129 criterion_2 <- (criterion_2a | criterion_2b | criterion_2c | criterion_2d)
130
131 ## PNU1 Criterion #3: symptoms/signs present
132 # Option A: pna_cdc3 == "Yes"
133 criterion_3a <- (!is.na(pna_cdc3) & pna_cdc3 == "Yes")
134
135 # Option B: If pna_cdc3 is missing, calculate from pna_symptoms
136 # Create 4 temporary variables
137 temp_var_1 <- (
138 (is_checked(pna_symptoms___1) | is_checked(pna_symptoms___2)) * 1
139 )
140
141 temp_var_2 <- (
142 (is_checked(pna_symptoms___4) | is_checked(pna_symptoms___5) | is_checked(pna_symptoms___6)) * 1
143 )
144
145 temp_var_3 <- is_checked(pna_symptoms___7) * 1
146
147 temp_var_4 <- is_checked(pna_symptoms___8) * 1
148
149 # Sum temporary variables; criterion met if pna_cdc3 is missing AND sum >= 2
150 symptom_sum <- temp_var_1 + temp_var_2 + temp_var_3 + temp_var_4
151 criterion_3b <- (is.na(pna_cdc3) & symptom_sum >= 2)
152
153 # Use Option A if pna_cdc3 available, otherwise Option B
154 criterion_3 <- (criterion_3a | criterion_3b)
155
156 ## Antimicrobial criterion
157 # Check if qualifying antivirals were administered
158 qualifying_antiviral <- daily_antiviral_0 == 'Administered' & (
159 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___2) |
160 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___6) |
161 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___7) |
162 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___8) |
163 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___9) |
164 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___10) |
165 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___11) |
166 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___12) |
167 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___13) |
168 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___15)
169 )
170
171 # Antimicrobial criterion met if any of these are true
172 antimicrobial_criterion <- (
173 daily_antibiotics_0 == 'Administered' |
174 qualifying_antiviral |
175 has_qualifying_pathogen
176 )
177
178 ## Determine pneumonia presence
179 # All 3 PNU1 criteria + antimicrobial criterion must be present
180 dplyr::case_when(
181 # All criteria met -> Pneumonia present
182 criterion_1 & criterion_2 & criterion_3 & antimicrobial_criterion ~ 1,
183
184 # At least one criterion definitively not met -> Pneumonia not present
185 (!is.na(criterion_1) & !criterion_1) |
186 (!is.na(criterion_2) & !criterion_2) |
187 (!is.na(criterion_3) & !criterion_3) |
188 (!is.na(antimicrobial_criterion) & !antimicrobial_criterion) ~ 0,
189
190 # Has valid responses that indicate no pneumonia -> Pneumonia not present
191 pna_cdc3 == 'No' ~ 0,
192 daily_antibiotics_0 %in% c('Administered', 'Not administered', 'UNK') ~ 0,
193 daily_antiviral_0 %in% c('Administered', 'Not administered', 'UNK') ~ 0,
194
195 # Otherwise -> Unknown
196 TRUE ~ NA_real_
197 )
198}

Presence of Sepsis Syndrome

R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_sys_sepsis_0.R · 177 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
sys_sepsis_0
Call
wrapper_calc_sys_sepsis_0(data, dictionary)
Key assumptions

Sepsis is defined only by Day 0 antimicrobial treatment or a qualifying pathogen, with no organ dysfunction criterion, and everything else defaults to 0.

  • The value 1 is assigned for Day 0 antibiotics Administered, a qualifying antiviral, a qualifying antifungal, or a qualifying respiratory pathogen.
  • A qualifying antiviral requires daily_antiviral_0 Administered and mh_antivirals_type 1, 2, 3, 6 to 13 or 15 from the Day 0 event.
  • A qualifying antifungal requires daily_antifungal_0 Administered and antifungal_agents_0 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 9 or 13 checked.
  • A qualifying pathogen has cxpos 3 and resp_pathogen codes 1 to 5, 7, 8 or 17 to 21 dated on or before enrollment, from the Hospital Discharge and Summary event.
  • The .default of 0 maps missing, UNK and unmatched values to 0, and records without a Daily In-Hospital Forms row return NA.
Possible issues to confirm
  • The header lists 99 as Unknown, but the code never returns 99.
  • Antiviral types are read from the Day 0 mh_antivirals_type fields, not a Day 0 daily field, while antifungal agents use the Day 0 daily field.
  • The antiviral code list includes 1 and 3 here but excludes them in calc_sys_pneumonia_0.R.

12 daily_antibiotics_0,
13 daily_antiviral_0,
14 daily_antifungal_0,
15 mh_antivirals_type___1,
16 mh_antivirals_type___2,
17 mh_antivirals_type___3,
18 mh_antivirals_type___6,
19 mh_antivirals_type___7,
20 mh_antivirals_type___8,
21 mh_antivirals_type___9,
22 mh_antivirals_type___10,
23 mh_antivirals_type___11,
24 mh_antivirals_type___12,
25 mh_antivirals_type___13,
26 mh_antivirals_type___15,
27 antifungal_agents_0___1,
28 antifungal_agents_0___2,
29 antifungal_agents_0___3,
30 antifungal_agents_0___6,
31 antifungal_agents_0___7,
32 antifungal_agents_0___9,
33 antifungal_agents_0___13,
34 has_qualifying_pathogen
35) {
36
37 # Check if qualifying antivirals were administered
38 qualifying_antiviral <- daily_antiviral_0 == 'Administered' & (
39 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___1) |
40 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___2) |
41 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___3) |
42 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___6) |
43 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___7) |
44 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___8) |
45 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___9) |
46 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___10) |
47 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___11) |
48 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___12) |
49 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___13) |
50 is_checked(mh_antivirals_type___15)
51 )
52
53 # Check if qualifying antifungals were administered
54 qualifying_antifungal <- daily_antifungal_0 == 'Administered' & (
55 is_checked(antifungal_agents_0___1) |
56 is_checked(antifungal_agents_0___2) |
57 is_checked(antifungal_agents_0___3) |
58 is_checked(antifungal_agents_0___6) |
59 is_checked(antifungal_agents_0___7) |
60 is_checked(antifungal_agents_0___9) |
61 is_checked(antifungal_agents_0___13)
62 )
63
64 # Sepsis is present if any of the criteria are met
65 dplyr::case_when(
66 daily_antibiotics_0 == 'Administered' |
67 qualifying_antiviral |
68 has_qualifying_pathogen |
69 qualifying_antifungal ~ 1,
70 .default = 0
71 )
72}

Respiratory Failure Severity

R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_sys_resp_failure_sev_0.R · 107 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
resp_support_type_0sfratio_8a_0
Call
wrapper_calc_sys_resp_failure_sev_0(data, dictionary)
Key assumptions

Day 0 8 am respiratory support type 1 to 6 or 99 plus S/F ratio, where daily SOFA Not Available is coded as no respiratory support.

  • Inputs are the 8 am Day 0 respiratory support code and settings from the Daily In-Hospital Forms event, with no lookback.
  • ECMO codes 1 or 2 map to 6, IMV code 3 maps to 6 if daily_epap_8a is at least 12 and to 5 if below 12, and both IMV levels require IMV FiO2.
  • NIV, HFNC and standard flow map to 4, 3 and 2 only when their FiO2 or flow field is present.
  • Code 7 or dailysofa_perf Not Available maps to 1, and code 99 maps to 99, with all other combinations NA.
  • S/F uses SpO2 over 0.21 for type 1, over 0.21 plus 0.03 times flow for type 2, and over the recorded FiO2 for types 3 to 6.
  • This file also defines calc_resp_support_type, which calc_sys_global_phys_sev_0.R depends on.
Possible issues to confirm
  • PEEP for IMV is read from daily_epap_8a, and IMV with missing EPAP gets NA support type.
  • Standard flow FiO2 is not capped at 1.0, and no SpO2 above 97 exclusion is applied, unlike calc_sf_ratio in support_functions.R.
  • Missing daily SOFA data are coded as no respiratory support rather than unknown.
  • ECMO without IMV FiO2 gets type 6 but an NA S/F ratio.
  • The output columns are named resp_support_type_0 and sfratio_8a_0 rather than with the sys_ prefix.
calc_resp_support_type()
Calculate SYSTEMATIC DAG 'Respiratory Failure Severity: Respiratory Support Type' for Day 0

Values:
- 1 = No respiratory support
- 2 = Standard flow oxygen
- 3 = High-flow nasal cannula (HFNC)
- 4 = Non-invasive ventilation (NIV)
- 5 = Invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV) with PEEP < 12 cm H2O, no ECMO
- 6 = IMV with PEEP ≥ 12 cm H2O, or ECMO
- 99 = Unknown
calc_sfratio_8a_0()
Calculate SYSTEMATIC DAG 'Respiratory Failure Severity: S/F Ratio' for Day 0

Value: SpO2/FiO2 ratio calculated as:
- Resp Support Type 1 (no support): SpO2 / 0.21
- Resp Support Type 2 (standard flow): SpO2 / (0.21 + 0.03 × O2 flow rate)
- Resp Support Types 3-6 (HFNC/NIV/IMV): SpO2 / FiO2

4
5# Calculate SYSTEMATIC DAG 'Respiratory Failure Severity: Respiratory Support Type' for Day 0
6#
7# Values:
8# - 1 = No respiratory support
9# - 2 = Standard flow oxygen
10# - 3 = High-flow nasal cannula (HFNC)
11# - 4 = Non-invasive ventilation (NIV)
12# - 5 = Invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV) with PEEP < 12 cm H2O, no ECMO
13# - 6 = IMV with PEEP ≥ 12 cm H2O, or ECMO
14# - 99 = Unknown
15calc_resp_support_type <- function(
16 daily_resp_8a_code,
17 dailysofa_perf,
18 daily_standard_flow_8a,
19 daily_hfnc_fi02_8a,
20 daily_niv_fi02_8a,
21 daily_imv_fio2_8a,
22 daily_epap_8a
23) {
24
25 dplyr::case_when(
26 # ECMO
27 daily_resp_8a_code %in% c(1, 2) ~ 6,
28 # IMV with PEEP >= 12 (same code as ECMO)
29 daily_resp_8a_code == 3 & !is.na(daily_imv_fio2_8a) & daily_epap_8a >= 12 ~ 6,
30 # IMV with PEEP < 12
31 daily_resp_8a_code == 3 & !is.na(daily_imv_fio2_8a) & daily_epap_8a < 12 ~ 5,
32 # NIV
33 (daily_resp_8a_code == 4) & !is.na(daily_niv_fi02_8a) ~ 4,
34 # HFNC
35 (daily_resp_8a_code == 5) & !is.na(daily_hfnc_fi02_8a) ~ 3,
36 # Standard flow
37 (daily_resp_8a_code == 6) & !is.na(daily_standard_flow_8a) ~ 2,
38 # No respiratory support on day 0 or not applicable
39 (daily_resp_8a_code == 7 | dailysofa_perf == 'Not Available') ~ 1,
40 # Unknown
41 daily_resp_8a_code == 99 ~ 99
42 )
43}
44
45# Calculate SYSTEMATIC DAG 'Respiratory Failure Severity: S/F Ratio' for Day 0
46#
47# Value: SpO2/FiO2 ratio calculated as:
48# - Resp Support Type 1 (no support): SpO2 / 0.21
49# - Resp Support Type 2 (standard flow): SpO2 / (0.21 + 0.03 × O2 flow rate)
50# - Resp Support Types 3-6 (HFNC/NIV/IMV): SpO2 / FiO2
51calc_sfratio_8a_0 <- function(
52 resp_support_type_0, # Calculated by calc_resp_support_type()
53 daily_spo2_8a_0,
54 daily_standard_flow_8a_0,
55 daily_hfnc_fi02_8a_0,
56 daily_niv_fi02_8a_0,
57 daily_imv_fio2_8a_0
58) {
59
60 dplyr::case_when(
61 resp_support_type_0 == 1 ~ daily_spo2_8a_0 / 0.21,
62 resp_support_type_0 == 2 ~ daily_spo2_8a_0 / (0.21 + (0.03 * daily_standard_flow_8a_0)),
63 resp_support_type_0 == 3 ~ daily_spo2_8a_0 / daily_hfnc_fi02_8a_0,
64 resp_support_type_0 == 4 ~ daily_spo2_8a_0 / daily_niv_fi02_8a_0,
65 resp_support_type_0 %in% c(5, 6) & !is.na(daily_imv_fio2_8a_0) ~ daily_spo2_8a_0 / daily_imv_fio2_8a_0
66 )
67}
68

R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_sys_septic_shock_0.R · 108 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
sys_septic_shock_0
Call
wrapper_calc_sys_septic_shock_0(data, dictionary)
Key assumptions

Septic shock is sepsis plus a Day 0 8 am norepinephrine equivalent above 0.5, applied to a dose in mcg/min, with all else defaulting to 0.

  • Sepsis comes from wrapper_calc_sys_sepsis_0, and an NA sepsis value results in 0.
  • Shock requires the vasopressor none box unchecked and NEE above 0.5 from calc_norepi_equivalents.
  • NEE uses mcg/min doses, falling back to mcg/kg/min times Day 0 weight, with missing doses set to 0 and dobutamine and milrinone excluded.
  • No MAP or lactate criterion is applied.
  • The .default of 0 covers missing data, and patients without a Day 0 event row return NA.
Possible issues to confirm
  • The NEE helper appears to return mcg/min while the 0.5 cutoff looks like a mcg/kg/min value; if so, most vasopressor doses would meet the threshold. Worth confirming the intended units with the authors.
  • Doses recorded only in mcg/kg/min become 0 when weight is missing.

24 m_weight_kg

32 daily_epi_dose_8a_0_mcgkg = daily_epi_dose_8a_0_mcgkg,

36 daily_dopa_dose_8a_0_mcg = daily_dopa_dose_8a_0_mcg,
37 daily_dopa_dos_8a_0_mcgkg = daily_dopa_dos_8a_0_mcgkg,

39 daily_ang2_8a_0_mcgkg = daily_ang2_8a_0_mcgkg,
40 m_weight_kg = m_weight_kg
41 )

Key assumptions

Coded 1 for any checked rheumatologic condition under mhrheumd Yes or pulmonary condition 6 under m_pulmonary Yes.

  • All inputs come from the Day 0 event.
  • The value 0 requires mhrheumd exactly No, all rheumatologic conditions 1 to 8 and 88 unchecked, m_pulmonary Yes or No, and pulmonary condition 6 unchecked.
  • The value 1 is assigned when either the rheumatologic or the pulmonary pathway is positive, even if the other parent field is Unknown.
  • The value 99 is assigned when mhrheumd or m_pulmonary is Unknown and no positive condition exists.

Active Vasculitis

R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_vasculitis_0.R · 59 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
str_vasculitis_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_vasculitis_0(data)
Key assumptions

Active vasculitis is 1 when rheum checkbox option 8 is checked and the patient has immunosuppression option 4 checked or chronic steroids (mhccster Yes).

  • The variable uses mhrheumd, m_rheum_conditions___8, m_immunosuppression, m_immunosup_conditions___4 and mhccster from the Day 0 event.
  • Active is defined by treatment, meaning option 8 checked plus either option 4 checked or mhccster Yes; no disease-activity field is used.
  • The 1 rule is evaluated first and does not require the parent fields mhrheumd or m_immunosuppression to be Yes.
  • The value is 0 when mhrheumd is answered with option 8 unchecked, or when option 4 is unchecked with an answered m_immunosuppression and mhccster No.
  • The value is 99 when any of mhccster, m_immunosuppression or mhrheumd is Unknown after earlier rules fail, and other gaps return NA.
Possible issues to confirm
  • The checked boxes take precedence over the parent questions, so inconsistent records with a parent answer of No are coded 1 rather than flagged.
  • Because the 0 rule runs before the 99 rule, a participant with mhccster Unknown but option 8 unchecked is coded 0.

14 m_immunosuppression,
15 m_immunosup_conditions___4,

18

21 ## Active vasculitis: has vasculitis AND (immunosuppression OR steroids)

24

29 is_unchecked(m_immunosup_conditions___4) &
30 mhccster == "No"
31 ) ~ 0,
32
33 ## Unknown status
34 is_unknown(mhccster) | is_unknown(m_immunosuppression) | is_unknown(mhrheumd) ~ 99
35 )
36}

R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_acute_allergic_reaction_0.R · 42 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory

str_acute_allergic_reaction_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_acute_allergic_reaction_0(data, dictionary)
Key assumptions

Acute allergic reaction is 1 only when the Syndrome Adjudication field organ_dysfnx_cause has code 2; codes 1, 3 and 99 (including unknown) are coded 0.

  • The variable uses a single field, organ_dysfnx_cause, from the Syndrome Adjudication event, mapped to its numeric code with get_code_label_map and the data dictionary.
  • Code 2 is the only value coded 1 (Yes).
  • Codes 1, 3 and 99 are all coded 0, so the code 99 category is treated as No rather than as unknown.
  • A blank organ_dysfnx_cause or any code other than 1, 2, 3 or 99 returns NA because the case_when has no .default.
  • There is no time window in the code; the value reflects a single adjudication record per participant.
Possible issues to confirm
  • The function body is identical across calc_str_acute_allergic_reaction_0, calc_str_cop_0, calc_str_dah_0 and calc_str_drug_toxicity_0, so all four variables take the same value for every participant.
  • Code 99 is collapsed into 0 (No), so an unknown adjudicated cause cannot be distinguished from a confirmed alternative cause.

Chronic Moderate-Dose Steroid Use

Compare with the systematic version
R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_chron_steroid_moddose_0.R · 46 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
str_chron_steroid_moddose_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_chron_steroid_moddose_0(data)
Key assumptions

Moderate-dose chronic steroid use is 1 when mhccster is Yes and adrenal insufficiency (m_endo_conditions___2) is not checked, with no dose threshold applied.

  • The variable uses mhccster, m_endocrine and checkbox m_endo_conditions___2 from the Day 0 event.
  • The first rule codes 0 when mhccster is No or when m_endocrine is Yes with option 2 checked, so adrenal insufficiency overrides any steroid use.
  • The value is 1 when mhccster is Yes, m_endocrine is Yes or No, and option 2 is unchecked.
  • The value is 99 when either mhccster or m_endocrine is Unknown, but only after the 0 and 1 rules fail.
  • Combinations not covered, such as mhccster missing with no adrenal insufficiency, return NA because there is no .default.
Possible issues to confirm
  • The code applies no dose threshold, so moderate dose means any chronic steroid use recorded in mhccster outside adrenal insufficiency.
  • Participants flagged as high dose in calc_str_chron_steroid_highdose_0 are not excluded, so the two variables can both equal 1.
  • Because the 0 rule is evaluated first, a participant with mhccster Unknown and adrenal insufficiency checked is coded 0 rather than 99.

R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_dah_0.R · 42 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory

str_dah_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_dah_0(data, dictionary)
Key assumptions

Diffuse alveolar hemorrhage is 1 only when the Syndrome Adjudication field organ_dysfnx_cause has code 2; codes 1, 3 and 99 (including unknown) are coded 0.

  • The variable uses a single field, organ_dysfnx_cause, from the Syndrome Adjudication event, mapped to its numeric code with get_code_label_map and the data dictionary.
  • Code 2 is the only value coded 1 (Yes).
  • Codes 1, 3 and 99 are all coded 0, so the code 99 category is treated as No rather than as unknown.
  • A blank organ_dysfnx_cause or any code other than 1, 2, 3 or 99 returns NA because the case_when has no .default.
  • There is no time window in the code; the value reflects a single adjudication record per participant.
Possible issues to confirm
  • The function body is identical across calc_str_acute_allergic_reaction_0, calc_str_cop_0, calc_str_dah_0 and calc_str_drug_toxicity_0, so all four variables take the same value for every participant.
  • Code 99 is collapsed into 0 (No), so an unknown adjudicated cause cannot be distinguished from a confirmed alternative cause.

Gastrointestinal Bleeding

R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_gi_bleeding_0.R · 105 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
str_gi_bleeding_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_gi_bleeding_0(data)
Key assumptions

The variable is the total PRBC units transfused across Days -2, -1 and 0, not a bleeding indicator, and an unknown transfusion status is imputed as 1 unit.

  • The variable uses daily_blood_product, blood_product_spec___1, blood_prbc_units and trx for Days -2, -1 and 0 from the Daily In-Hospital Forms event.
  • For each day, Administered with PRBC (option 1) checked contributes the recorded blood_prbc_units value.
  • For each day, UNK with PRBC unchecked contributes 1 unit.
  • For each day, Administered or Not administered with PRBC unchecked contributes 0, and trx equal to Not Available contributes 0.
  • Daily values are summed with na.rm = FALSE, so any day that matches no rule, or has missing units, makes the 3-day total NA.
Possible issues to confirm
  • The header names the variable Gastrointestinal Bleeding but the code returns PRBC units from any cause, with no GI bleeding field used.
  • Imputing 1 unit when blood product status is UNK and PRBC is unchecked is a strong assumption that inflates totals.
  • Not administered with PRBC checked, or UNK with PRBC checked, matches no rule unless trx is Not Available, and produces NA.
  • Administered with PRBC checked but missing blood_prbc_units makes the whole total NA rather than falling back to another rule.

Show full source (105 lines)
1## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
2## Gastrointestinal Bleeding (Streamlined DAG)
3## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
4
5# Calculate STREAMLINED DAG 'Gastrointestinal Bleeding'
6#
7# Value: Total packed red blood cell (PRBC) units transfused
8calc_str_gi_bleeding_0 <- function(
9 trx_0,
10 trx_m1,
11 trx_m2,
12 blood_prbc_units_m2,
13 blood_prbc_units_m1,
14 blood_prbc_units_0,
15 daily_blood_product_m2,
16 daily_blood_product_m1,
17 daily_blood_product_0,
18 blood_product_spec_m2___1,
19 blood_product_spec_m1___1,
20 blood_product_spec_0___1
21) {
22
23 # Day -2:
24 prbc_m2 <- dplyr::case_when(
25 (daily_blood_product_m2 == "Administered" &
26 is_checked(blood_product_spec_m2___1)) ~ blood_prbc_units_m2,
27
28 (daily_blood_product_m2 == "UNK" &
29 is_unchecked(blood_product_spec_m2___1)) ~ 1,
30
31 (daily_blood_product_m2 %in% c("Administered", "Not administered") &
32 is_unchecked(blood_product_spec_m2___1)) ~ 0,
33
34 (trx_m2 == 'Not Available') ~ 0
35 )
36
37 # Day -1:
38 prbc_m1 <- dplyr::case_when(
39 (daily_blood_product_m1 == "Administered" &
40 is_checked(blood_product_spec_m1___1)) ~ blood_prbc_units_m1,
41
42 (daily_blood_product_m1 == "UNK" &
43 is_unchecked(blood_product_spec_m1___1)) ~ 1,
44
45 (daily_blood_product_m1 %in% c("Administered", "Not administered") &
46 is_unchecked(blood_product_spec_m1___1)) ~ 0,
47
48 (trx_m1 == 'Not Available') ~ 0
49 )
50
51 # Day 0:
52 prbc_0 <- dplyr::case_when(
53 (daily_blood_product_0 == "Administered" &
54 is_checked(blood_product_spec_0___1)) ~ blood_prbc_units_0,
55
56 (daily_blood_product_0 == "UNK" &
57 is_unchecked(blood_product_spec_0___1)) ~ 1,
58
59 (daily_blood_product_0 %in% c("Administered", "Not administered") &
60 is_unchecked(blood_product_spec_0___1)) ~ 0,
61
62 (trx_0 == 'Not Available') ~ 0 # If missing for valid reasons, assume 0 units
63 )
64
65 # Sum PRBC units across all three days
66 # - If any day has invalid configuration, return NA
67 # - Otherwise sum all days (values and 0s)
68 total_prbc <- rowSums(
69 cbind(prbc_m2, prbc_m1, prbc_0),
70 na.rm = FALSE
71 )
72
73 return(total_prbc)
74}
75
76

80 data |>
81 # Ensure one row per record_id (even if data is missing)
82 distinct(record_id) |>
83
84 left_join(
85 # Calculate str_gi_bleeding_0 and join back to record_id
86 data |>
87 filter(event_label == 'Daily In-Hospital Forms') |>
88 mutate(str_gi_bleeding_0 = calc_str_gi_bleeding_0(
89 trx_0 = trx_0,
90 trx_m1 = trx_m1,
91 trx_m2 = trx_m2,
92 blood_prbc_units_m2 = blood_prbc_units_m2,
93 blood_prbc_units_m1 = blood_prbc_units_m1,
94 blood_prbc_units_0 = blood_prbc_units_0,
95 daily_blood_product_m2 = daily_blood_product_m2,
96 daily_blood_product_m1 = daily_blood_product_m1,
97 daily_blood_product_0 = daily_blood_product_0,
98 blood_product_spec_m2___1 = blood_product_spec_m2___1,
99 blood_product_spec_m1___1 = blood_product_spec_m1___1,
100 blood_product_spec_0___1 = blood_product_spec_0___1
101 )) |>

103 by = 'record_id'
104 )

Key assumptions

Hyperglycemia is 1 only when the Day 0 8 am glucose exceeds 250, and missing glucose is coded 0.

  • The variable uses daily_gluc_8a_0 and daily_gluc_nc_0 from the Daily In-Hospital Forms event, Day 0 only, with no lookback.
  • The threshold is strictly greater than 250, presumably mg/dL, and 250 itself is coded 0.
  • A missing Day 0 glucose is coded 0 by the second rule, so not measured is treated as normal.
  • The variable reflects a single 8 am value rather than any history of hyperglycemia despite the hist suffix.
Possible issues to confirm
  • The third rule for daily_gluc_nc_0 equal to Not Collected is unreachable because missing glucose is already coded 0 by the second rule.
  • The threshold differs from calc_str_psi_score_0, which uses glucose of 250 or more with a lookback to Day -2.

Hypotension Severity

Compare with the systematic version
R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_hypotension_sev_0.R · 166 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
str_hypotension_sev_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_hypotension_sev_0(data)
Key assumptions

Day 0 8 am ordinal hypotension score 0 to 5 built from MAP, inotropes and norepinephrine equivalents (NEE), with cutoffs of 0.1 and 0.25 NEE for the top levels.

  • The variable uses Day 0 8 am vasopressor checkboxes, doses, SBP and DBP from Daily In-Hospital Forms, plus m_weight_kg from the Day 0 event.
  • MAP is (2 times DBP plus SBP) divided by 3, and scores 0 and 1 require the none checkbox (___0) checked with MAP of 70 or more, or below 70.
  • Score 2 requires dobutamine or milrinone checked, dopamine of 5 mcg/kg/min or less, and no other vasopressor checked.
  • Scores 3, 4 and 5 use NEE of 0.1 or less (any agent checked), above 0.1 and below 0.25, and 0.25 or more.
  • Missing doses are coalesced to 0, preferring the mcg/min field and otherwise multiplying the mcg/kg/min field by weight.
  • Rules are evaluated in order, so a checked none box yields 0 or 1 even if a vasopressor is also checked.
Possible issues to confirm
  • calc_norepi_equivalents appears to return mcg/min while the 0.1 and 0.25 cutoffs look like mcg/kg/min values; if so, most infusions would score 5. Worth confirming the intended units with the authors.
  • The NEE helper multiplies vasopressin units/min by 2.5 and angiotensin II by 10 while other agents stay in mcg/min, which mixes unit scales.
  • A vasopressor checked with all doses missing gets NEE 0 and is scored 3 regardless of the actual dose.
  • The none box checked with missing SBP or DBP returns NA, as does a record with no vasopressor box checked.
  • dobuta_dose and milr_dose are computed but never used.
calc_str_hypotension_sev_0()
Calculate STREAMLINED DAG 'Hypotension Severity'

Values:
- 0 = No pressors or inotrope, MAP >= 70
- 1 = No pressors or inotrope, MAP < 70
- 2 = On dobutamine/milrinone only (with low/no dopamine)
- 3 = On vasopressors with NEE <= 0.1
- 4 = NEE > 0.1 AND NEE < 0.25
- 5 = NEE >= 0.25

2## Hypotension Severity (Streamlined DAG)
3## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
4
5# Calculate STREAMLINED DAG 'Hypotension Severity'
6#
7# Values:
8# - 0 = No pressors or inotrope, MAP >= 70
9# - 1 = No pressors or inotrope, MAP < 70
10# - 2 = On dobutamine/milrinone only (with low/no dopamine)
11# - 3 = On vasopressors with NEE <= 0.1
12# - 4 = NEE > 0.1 AND NEE < 0.25
13# - 5 = NEE >= 0.25
14calc_str_hypotension_sev_0 <- function(
15 daily_vasopressors_0___0,
16 daily_vasopressors_0___1,
17 daily_vasopressors_0___2,
18 daily_vasopressors_0___3,
19 daily_vasopressors_0___4,
20 daily_vasopressors_0___5,
21 daily_vasopressors_0___6,
22 daily_vasopressors_0___7,
23 daily_vasopressors_0___8,
24 daily_vasopressors_0___88,
25
26 daily_sbp_8a_0,
27 daily_dbp_8a_0,
28
29 daily_ne_dose_8a_0_mcg,
30 daily_ne_dose_8a_0_mcgkg,
31 daily_epi_dose_8a_0_mcg,
32 daily_epi_dose_8a_0_mcgkg,
33 daily_phen_dose_8a_0_mcg,
34 daily_phen_dos_8a_0_mcgkg,
35 daily_vaso_dose_8a_0,
36 daily_dopa_dose_8a_0_mcg,
37 daily_dopa_dos_8a_0_mcgkg,
38 daily_dobuta_8a_0_mcg,
39 daily_dobuta_8a_0_mcgkg,
40 daily_ang2_8a_0_mcg,
41 daily_ang2_8a_0_mcgkg,
42 daily_milr_8a_0_mcg,
43 daily_milr_8a_0_mcgkg,
44
45 m_weight_kg
46) {
47
48 ## Calculate MAP from SBP and DBP: MAP = (2 * DBP + SBP) / 3
49 map <- (2 * daily_dbp_8a_0 + daily_sbp_8a_0) / 3
50
51 ## Calculate norepinephrine equivalents (for vasopressors only)
52 norepi_equiv <- calc_norepi_equivalents(
53 daily_ne_dose_8a_0_mcg = daily_ne_dose_8a_0_mcg,
54 daily_ne_dose_8a_0_mcgkg = daily_ne_dose_8a_0_mcgkg,
55 daily_epi_dose_8a_0_mcg = daily_epi_dose_8a_0_mcg,
56 daily_epi_dose_8a_0_mcgkg = daily_epi_dose_8a_0_mcgkg,
57 daily_phen_dose_8a_0_mcg = daily_phen_dose_8a_0_mcg,
58 daily_phen_dos_8a_0_mcgkg = daily_phen_dos_8a_0_mcgkg,
59 daily_vaso_dose_8a_0 = daily_vaso_dose_8a_0,
60 daily_dopa_dose_8a_0_mcg = daily_dopa_dose_8a_0_mcg,
61 daily_dopa_dos_8a_0_mcgkg = daily_dopa_dos_8a_0_mcgkg,
62 daily_ang2_8a_0_mcg = daily_ang2_8a_0_mcg,
63 daily_ang2_8a_0_mcgkg = daily_ang2_8a_0_mcgkg,
64 m_weight_kg = m_weight_kg
65 )
66
67 ## Calculate dopamine dose in mcg/min/kg for threshold check
68 dopa_dose_mcgkg <- dplyr::coalesce(daily_dopa_dos_8a_0_mcgkg, daily_dopa_dose_8a_0_mcg / m_weight_kg, 0)
69
70 ## Calculate dobutamine and milrinone doses
71 dobuta_dose <- dplyr::coalesce(daily_dobuta_8a_0_mcg, daily_dobuta_8a_0_mcgkg * m_weight_kg, 0)
72 milr_dose <- dplyr::coalesce(daily_milr_8a_0_mcg, daily_milr_8a_0_mcgkg * m_weight_kg, 0)
73
74 ## Check if on any vasopressors (NE, epi, phenylephrine, vasopressin, angiotensin II)
75 on_vasopressors <- is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___1) | # norepinephrine
76 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___2) | # epinephrine
77 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___3) | # phenylephrine
78 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___4) | # vasopressin
79 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___5) | # dopamine
80 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___6) | # dobutamine
81 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___7) | # angiotensin II
82 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___8) | # milrinone
83 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___88) # Other
84
85 ## Check if on OTHER vasopressors (excludes dopamine, dobutamine, milrinone)
86 on_other_vasopressors <- is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___1) | # norepinephrine
87 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___2) | # epinephrine
88 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___3) | # phenylephrine
89 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___4) | # vasopressin
90 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___7) | # angiotensin II
91 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___88) # Other
92
93 dplyr::case_when(
94 # Score 0: No pressors/inotropes, MAP ≥ 70
95 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___0) & (map >= 70) ~ 0,
96
97 # Score 1: No pressors/inotropes, MAP < 70
98 is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___0) & (map < 70) ~ 1,
99
100 # Score 2: (dobutamine/milrinone) AND (no or <= 5 dopamine) AND (no other vasopressors)
101 (is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___6) | is_checked(daily_vasopressors_0___8)) &
102 (dopa_dose_mcgkg <= 5) & !on_other_vasopressors ~ 2,
103
104 # Score 3: On vasopressors with NEE ≤ 0.1
105 on_vasopressors & (norepi_equiv <= 0.1) ~ 3,
106
107 # Score 4: 0.1 < NEE < 0.25
108 norepi_equiv > 0.1 & norepi_equiv < 0.25 ~ 4,
109
110 # Score 5: NEE >= 0.25
111 norepi_equiv >= 0.25 ~ 5
112 )
113}

Inflammatory Profile

Compare with the systematic version
R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_inflamprofile_0.R · 52 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
str_inflamprofile_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_inflamprofile_0(data)
Key assumptions

CRP is coded 2 if 15 mg/L or more, 1 if below 15, or 0 if Not Collected, using the latest value from Day 0 to Day -2.

  • The variable calls calc_crp_0 from the systematic DAG with daily_crp_8a and daily_crp_nc for Days 0, -1 and -2 from Daily In-Hospital Forms.
  • Day 0 CRP is used first, Day -1 only if Day 0 is missing, and Day -2 only if both are missing.
  • The value is 2 for CRP of 15 mg/L or more and 1 for CRP below 15 mg/L.
  • The value is 0 when no CRP value exists and any of the three days is marked Not Collected.
  • A missing CRP with no Not Collected flag on any day returns NA.
Possible issues to confirm
  • In calc_crp_0 the comment on the second rule says CRP of 15 or more, but the code tests for CRP below 15.
  • Code 0 means not checked, so the ordinal coding places unmeasured below low CRP rather than treating it as missing.

R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_major_surgery_0.R · 50 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory

str_major_surgery_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_major_surgery_0(data)
Key assumptions

Surgery is 1 if daily_surgery equals Administered on Day -2, -1 or 0, and every other case, including missing, defaults to 0.

  • The variable uses daily_surgery for Days -2, -1 and 0 from the Daily In-Hospital Forms event.
  • Yes means daily_surgery equals the string Administered on at least one of the three days.
  • The .default of 0 maps missing, unknown and any other response to 0.
  • The code does not distinguish major from minor surgery; any surgery recorded as Administered counts.
Possible issues to confirm
  • Missing or unknown surgery status on all three days is silently coded 0 rather than NA or 99.
  • The header says Major Recent Surgery but no field in the code captures surgery type or magnitude.

R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_psi_score_0.R · 274 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
str_psi_score_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_psi_score_0(data)
Key assumptions

PSI is summed from age and point items in which any missing component contributes 0 points, so missing data lowers rather than nulls the score.

  • Age, sex, residence, comorbidities, baseline CNS fields and worst vitals come from Day 0, labs and GCS from Daily In-Hospital Forms, and pna_effusion from Syndrome Adjudication.
  • Points are minus 10 for female, plus 10 for rehabilitation, LTACH or nursing home or SNF residence, and plus 30 cancer, 20 cirrhosis, 10 each for CHF, stroke or TIA, and CKD.
  • Altered mental status (plus 20) requires CAM positive on Day 0 or GCS below 15 without baseline CNS dysfunction, or a drop below the chronic GCS band with it.
  • GCS uses the latest Day 0 to Day -2 value without a T and not documented, defaulting to 15, and missing baseline CNS status is treated as No.
  • Vitals score RR 30 or more (20), SBP below 90 (20), low or high temperature below 35 or 40 or more (15), and HR 125 or more (10).
  • Labs take the latest Day 0 to Day -2 value and score pH below 7.35 (30), BUN 30 or more (20), Na below 130 (20), glucose 250 or more (10), Hct below 30 (10), PaO2 below 60 (10).
  • Every item except age and sex uses missing = 0, so absent data adds no points.
Possible issues to confirm
  • Missing age or missing sex makes the whole score NA because sex uses if_else without missing = 0.
  • Residence in a rehabilitation facility or LTACH is scored as nursing home residence.
  • pH and PaO2 are taken from the daily lowest value fields, and the code does not confirm the pH is arterial.
  • Baseline CNS dysfunction Yes with a chronic GCS band other than 13-14, 10-12 or 6-9, or missing, can never score altered mental status.
  • GCS values containing T are skipped and, if no other value exists, GCS defaults to 15, so intubated patients score from CAM alone.

1## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
2## PSI Score (Streamlined DAG)
3## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
4
5# Calculate STREAMLINED DAG 'PSI Score'
6#
7# Value: Pneumonia Severity Index (PSI) score
8calc_str_psi_score_0 <- function(
9 age,
10 sex,
11 prssrc,
12
13 m_cv_conditions___2,
14 m_neurologic_conditions___2,
15 m_neurologic_conditions___3,
16 m_cancer,
17 m_kid_liver_conditions___1,
18 m_kid_liver_conditions___2,
19
20 cam_0,
21
22 daily_gcs_8a_0,
23 daily_gcs_8a_m1,
24 daily_gcs_8a_m2,
25
26 sofa_base_cns_dysnfx,
27 sofa_base_gcs_chronic,
28
29 highhr_vsorres,
30 highrr_vsorres,
31 lowsysbp_vsorres,
32 lowtemp_vsorres,
33 hightemp_vsorres,
34
35 daily_bun_8a_0,
36 daily_bun_8a_m1,
37 daily_bun_8a_m2,
38
39 daily_gluc_8a_0,
40 daily_gluc_8a_m1,
41 daily_gluc_8a_m2,
42
43 daily_hct_8a_0,
44 daily_hct_8a_m1,
45 daily_hct_8a_m2,
46
47 daily_na_8a_0,
48 daily_na_8a_m1,
49 daily_na_8a_m2,
50
51 daily_pa02_lowest_0,
52 daily_pa02_lowest_m1,
53 daily_pa02_lowest_m2,
54
55 daily_ph_lowest_0,
56 daily_ph_lowest_m1,
57 daily_ph_lowest_m2,
58
59 pna_effusion
60) {
61
62 # Demographics
63
64 # - Age
65 score <- age
66
67 # - Sex: Female -10 points
68 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(sex == "Female", -10, 0)
69
70
71 # Nursing home resident: +10 points
72 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(
73 prssrc %in% c(
74 'Rehabilitation facility',
75 'Long term acute care hospital (LTACH)',
76 'Nursing home or Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)'
77 ), 10,
78 0,
79 missing = 0
80 )
81
82 # Coexisting Illnesses
83 # - Neoplastic disease: +30 points
84 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(m_cancer == "Yes", 30, 0, missing = 0)
85
86 # - Liver disease: +20 points (Cirrhosis)
87 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(is_checked(m_kid_liver_conditions___2), 20, 0, missing = 0)
88
89 # - Congestive heart failure: +10 points
90 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(is_checked(m_cv_conditions___2), 10, 0, missing = 0)
91
92 # - Cerebrovascular disease: +10 points (Prior stroke or TIA)
93 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(
94 is_checked(m_neurologic_conditions___2) | is_checked(m_neurologic_conditions___3), 10,
95 0,
96 missing = 0
97 )
98
99 # - Renal disease: +10 points (Chronic kidney disease)
100 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(is_checked(m_kid_liver_conditions___1), 10, 0, missing = 0)
101
102 # Physical examination findings
103
104 # - Altered mental status: +20 points
105
106 # Get GCS with lookback (excluding T values and "not documented")
107 gcs <- get_gcs_with_lookback(daily_gcs_8a_0, daily_gcs_8a_m1, daily_gcs_8a_m2)
108 gcs_numeric <- as.numeric(gcs)
109
110 # Get CAM value
111 cam_positive <- cam_0 == "Positive for delirium at least once on this day"
112
113 # Calculate altered mental status based on the two conditions
114 altered_mental_status <- dplyr::case_when(
115 # Condition 1: No baseline CNS dysfunction (or missing) AND (CAM positive OR GCS < 15)
116 (is.na(sofa_base_cns_dysnfx) | sofa_base_cns_dysnfx == "No") &
117 (cam_positive | gcs_numeric < 15) ~ TRUE,
118
119 # Condition 2: Has baseline CNS dysfunction AND GCS meets chronic threshold
120 sofa_base_cns_dysnfx == "Yes" & (
121 (sofa_base_gcs_chronic == "13-14" & gcs_numeric <= 12) |
122 (sofa_base_gcs_chronic == "10-12" & gcs_numeric <= 9) |
123 (sofa_base_gcs_chronic == "6-9" & gcs_numeric <= 5)
124 ) ~ TRUE,
125
126 # Default: no altered mental status
127 .default = FALSE
128 )
129
130 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(altered_mental_status, 20, 0, missing = 0)
131
132 # - Respiratory rate >= 30/min: +20 points
133 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(highrr_vsorres >= 30, 20, 0, missing = 0)
134
135 # - SBP < 90 mm Hg: +20 points
136 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(lowsysbp_vsorres < 90, 20, 0, missing = 0)
137
138 # - Temperature < 35°C or >= 40°C: +15 points
139 temp_abnormal <- (lowtemp_vsorres < 35) | (lowtemp_vsorres >= 40) |
140 (hightemp_vsorres < 35) | (hightemp_vsorres >= 40)
141 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(temp_abnormal, 15, 0, missing = 0)
142
143 # - Pulse >= 125/min: +10 points
144 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(highhr_vsorres >= 125, 10, 0, missing = 0)
145
146
147 # Laboratory and radiographic findings
148
149 # - Arterial pH < 7.35: +30 points
150 ph_lowest <- get_value_with_lookback(daily_ph_lowest_0, daily_ph_lowest_m1, daily_ph_lowest_m2)
151 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(ph_lowest < 7.35, 30, 0, missing = 0)
152
153 # - BUN >= 30 mg/dl: +20 points
154 bun <- get_value_with_lookback(daily_bun_8a_0, daily_bun_8a_m1, daily_bun_8a_m2)
155 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(bun >= 30, 20, 0, missing = 0)
156
157 # - Sodium < 130 mmol/L: +20 points
158 na <- get_value_with_lookback(daily_na_8a_0, daily_na_8a_m1, daily_na_8a_m2)
159 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(na < 130, 20, 0, missing = 0)
160
161 # - Glucose >= 250 mg/dl: +10 points
162 gluc <- get_value_with_lookback(daily_gluc_8a_0, daily_gluc_8a_m1, daily_gluc_8a_m2)
163 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(gluc >= 250, 10, 0, missing = 0)
164
165 # - Hematocrit < 30%: +10 points
166 hct <- get_value_with_lookback(daily_hct_8a_0, daily_hct_8a_m1, daily_hct_8a_m2)
167 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(hct < 30, 10, 0, missing = 0)
168
169 # - PaO2 < 60 mm Hg: +10 points
170 pa02_lowest <- get_value_with_lookback(daily_pa02_lowest_0, daily_pa02_lowest_m1, daily_pa02_lowest_m2)
171 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(pa02_lowest < 60, 10, 0, missing = 0)
172
173 # - Pleural effusion: +10 points (pna_effusion = Yes)
174 score <- score + dplyr::if_else(pna_effusion == "Yes", 10, 0, missing = 0)
175
176 return(score)
177}

SCAP Criterion: Acidosis

R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_scap_acidosis_0.R · 47 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
str_scap_acidosis_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_scap_acidosis_0(data)
Key assumptions

Acidosis is 1 when the most recent lowest pH from Day 0 back to Day -2 is below 7.30, and missing pH defaults to 0.

  • The variable uses daily_ph_lowest for Days 0, -1 and -2 from the Daily In-Hospital Forms event.
  • The pH value is the first non-missing of Day 0, then Day -1, then Day -2, so an earlier day is used only when later days are missing.
  • The threshold is strictly below 7.30, and 7.30 itself is coded 0.
  • The .default of 0 codes missing pH on all three days as 0, so no blood gas is treated as no acidosis.
Possible issues to confirm
  • Missing pH is coded 0 here, while the sibling SCAP criteria for BUN, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, hypothermia and RR return NA when missing.

Key assumptions

BUN criterion is 1 when the most recent 8 am BUN from Day 0 back to Day -2 exceeds 30 mg/dL, with missing values left as NA.

  • The variable uses daily_bun_8a for Days 0, -1 and -2 from the Daily In-Hospital Forms event.
  • The value used is the first non-missing of Day 0, then Day -1, then Day -2.
  • The value is 1 for BUN above 30 mg/dL and 0 for 30 or below.
  • Missing BUN on all three days returns NA because there is no .default.
Possible issues to confirm
  • The cutoff differs from calc_str_psi_score_0, which awards points for BUN of 30 or more, so a BUN of exactly 30 is handled differently between the two.

SCAP Criterion: Bilateral Opacities

R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_scap_bilateral_opacities_0.R · 123 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
str_scap_bilateral_opacities_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_scap_bilateral_opacities_0(data, dictionary)
Key assumptions

Bilateral opacities is 1 if any CXR or CT opacity code equals 2 on Day -2, -1 or 0, and 0 requires every day to have valid no-opacity data.

  • The variable uses cxr and ct availability and opacity fields for Days -2, -1 and 0 from the Syndrome Adjudication event, with opacity mapped to dictionary codes.
  • Yes means opacity code 2 on any of the six imaging fields, and this rule takes precedence.
  • A day counts as no opacity if the CXR opacity code is 00, 0, 1 or 99, or if both cxr and ct availability are answered Yes or No.
  • The value is 0 only when all three days meet the no-opacity condition; otherwise the result is NA, which the comment says should be queried.
Possible issues to confirm
  • Opacity code 99 is grouped with no opacity, so unknown imaging findings are coded 0.
  • A day with availability answered Yes but no opacity code recorded still counts as no opacity through the availability branch.
  • The method 2 check looks only at the CXR opacity code, so a CT opacity code is never used to confirm absence.
calc_str_scap_bilateral_opacities_0()
Calculate STREAMLINED DAG 'SCAP Criterion: Bilateral Opacities'

Values:
- 0 = No
- 1 = Yes

1## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
2## SCAP Criterion: Bilateral Opacities (Streamlined DAG)
3## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
4
5# Calculate STREAMLINED DAG 'SCAP Criterion: Bilateral Opacities'
6#
7# Values:
8# - 0 = No
9# - 1 = Yes
10calc_str_scap_bilateral_opacities_0 <- function(
11 cxr_dm2_available,
12 cxr_dm2_opacity_code,
13 ct_dm2_available,
14 ct_dm2_opacity_code,
15
16 cxr_dm1_available,
17 cxr_dm1_opacity_code,
18 ct_dm1_available,
19 ct_dm1_opacity_code,
20
21 cxr_d0_available,
22 cxr_d0_opacity_code,
23 ct_d0_available,
24 ct_d0_opacity_code
25) {
26
27 ## Check if any opacity value is "2" (bilateral)
28 has_opacity <- (
29 cxr_dm2_opacity_code == "2" |
30 ct_dm2_opacity_code == "2" |
31
32 cxr_dm1_opacity_code == "2" |
33 ct_dm1_opacity_code == "2" |
34
35 cxr_d0_opacity_code == "2" |
36 ct_d0_opacity_code == "2"
37 )
38
39 # Two methods were used in assembling these variables:
40 # Method 1 - cxr/ct_available indicates if imaging was done, with the result stored in cxr/ct_opacity (if present)
41 # Method 2 - cxr_opacity set to "00" or "0" indicates nothing was found for BOTH cxr and ct
42 # Thus we check both options for each day and if any day has invalid data, it should be queried
43 has_no_opacity <- (
44
45 # Day -2
46 (
47 (cxr_dm2_opacity_code %in% c("00", "0", "1", "99")) |
48 (cxr_dm2_available %in% c("No", "Yes") & ct_dm2_available %in% c("No", "Yes"))
49 ) &
50
51 # Day -1
52 (
53 (cxr_dm1_opacity_code %in% c("00", "0", "1", "99")) |
54 (cxr_dm1_available %in% c("No", "Yes") & ct_dm1_available %in% c("No", "Yes"))
55 ) &
56
57 # Day 0
58 (
59 (cxr_d0_opacity_code %in% c("00", "0", "1", "99")) |
60 (cxr_d0_available %in% c("No", "Yes") & ct_d0_available %in% c("No", "Yes"))
61 )
62 )
63
64 dplyr::case_when(
65 has_opacity ~ 1,
66 has_no_opacity ~ 0
67 )
68}
69
70

78 left_join(
79 # Calculate str_scap_bilateral_opacities_0 and join back to record_id
80 data |>
81 filter(event_label == 'Syndrome Adjudication') |>
82 left_join(
83 get_code_label_map('cxr_dm2_opacity', dictionary),
84 by = 'cxr_dm2_opacity'
85 ) |>

87 get_code_label_map('ct_dm2_opacity', dictionary),

101 ) |>
102 left_join(

107 cxr_dm2_available = cxr_dm2_available,

109 ct_dm2_available = ct_dm2_available,

Key assumptions

Hypothermia is 1 when the Day 0 lowest temperature is below 35.0 C, with no lookback and missing values left as NA.

  • The variable uses lowtemp_vsorres from the Day 0 event only.
  • The value is 1 for a temperature below 35.0 and 0 for 35.0 or above, with units assumed to be Celsius per the header.
  • Missing lowtemp_vsorres returns NA because there is no .default.
  • Unlike the lab-based SCAP criteria, there is no lookback to Day -1 or Day -2.

SCAP Criterion: Respiratory Rate

R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_scap_rr_0.R · 169 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
str_scap_rr_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_scap_rr_0(data, dictionary)
Key assumptions

Respiratory rate above 30 is taken from the support-specific 8 am RR field, falling back to the Day 0 highest RR for room air, ECMO without IMV or unknown support.

  • The variable uses daily_resp_8a support codes and the IMV, NIV, HFNC and standard oxygen RR fields for Days 0, -1 and -2, plus highrr_vsorres from Day 0.
  • Support codes 1 and 3 use daily_resp_rate, code 4 uses NIV RR, code 5 HFNC RR, code 6 standard oxygen RR, and codes 2, 7 and 99 use highrr_vsorres.
  • The daily RR used is the first non-missing of Day 0, then Day -1, then Day -2.
  • The value is 1 for RR above 30 and 0 for 30 or below.
  • Missing RR on all three days, or a missing support code on all three days, returns NA.
Possible issues to confirm
  • The same Day 0 highrr_vsorres value is substituted for Days -1 and -2 when those days are room air, ECMO without IMV or unknown, so it is not day-specific.
  • The fallback mixes a daily highest RR with 8 am RR values from other support types, which may not be comparable.
  • The cutoff differs from calc_str_psi_score_0, which scores RR of 30 or more, so RR of exactly 30 is handled differently.

5# Calculate STREAMLINED DAG 'SCAP Criterion: Respiratory Rate'
6#
7# Values:
8# - 0 = No (Respiratory rate <= 30)
9# - 1 = Yes (Respiratory rate > 30)
10calc_str_scap_rr_0 <- function(
11 daily_resp_8a_0_code,
12 daily_resp_8a_m1_code,
13 daily_resp_8a_m2_code,
14
15 daily_hfnc_rr_8a_0,
16 daily_hfnc_rr_8a_m1,
17 daily_hfnc_rr_8a_m2,
18
19 daily_niv_rr_8a_0,
20 daily_niv_rr_8a_m1,
21 daily_niv_rr_8a_m2,
22
23 daily_standard_rr_8a_0,
24 daily_standard_rr_8a_m1,
25 daily_standard_rr_8a_m2,
26
27 daily_resp_rate_8a_0,
28 daily_resp_rate_8a_m1,
29 daily_resp_rate_8a_m2,
30
31 highrr_vsorres
32 ) {
33
34 ## Helper function to get RR based on respiratory support type
35 get_rr_for_support <- function(resp_code, imv_rr, niv_rr, hfnc_rr, standard_rr, high_rr) {
36 dplyr::case_when(
37 resp_code == 1 ~ imv_rr, # ECMO and IMV
38 resp_code == 2 ~ high_rr, # ECMO without IMV
39 resp_code == 3 ~ imv_rr, # IMV without ECMO
40 resp_code == 4 ~ niv_rr, # Non-invasive ventilation
41 resp_code == 5 ~ hfnc_rr, # High-flow nasal oxygen (HFNC)
42 resp_code == 6 ~ standard_rr, # Standard flow supplemental oxygen
43 resp_code == 7 ~ high_rr, # No respiratory support (room air)
44 resp_code == 99 ~ high_rr # Unknown
45 )
46 }
47
48 ## Get RR for each day
49 rr_0 <- get_rr_for_support(
50 daily_resp_8a_0_code,
51 daily_resp_rate_8a_0,
52 daily_niv_rr_8a_0,
53 daily_hfnc_rr_8a_0,
54 daily_standard_rr_8a_0,
55 highrr_vsorres
56 )
57
58 rr_m1 <- get_rr_for_support(
59 daily_resp_8a_m1_code,
60 daily_resp_rate_8a_m1,
61 daily_niv_rr_8a_m1,
62 daily_hfnc_rr_8a_m1,
63 daily_standard_rr_8a_m1,
64 highrr_vsorres
65 )
66
67 rr_m2 <- get_rr_for_support(
68 daily_resp_8a_m2_code,
69 daily_resp_rate_8a_m2,
70 daily_niv_rr_8a_m2,
71 daily_hfnc_rr_8a_m2,
72 daily_standard_rr_8a_m2,
73 highrr_vsorres
74 )
75
76 ## Get final RR with lookback (Day 0 -> Day -1 -> Day -2)
77 rr <- get_value_with_lookback(rr_0, rr_m1, rr_m2)
78
79 ## Apply SCAP criterion
80 dplyr::case_when(
81 rr <= 30 ~ 0,
82 rr > 30 ~ 1
83 )
84}

SCAP Criterion: Thrombocytopenia

R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_scap_thrombocytopenia_0.R · 46 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
str_scap_thrombocytopenia_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_scap_thrombocytopenia_0(data)
Key assumptions

Thrombocytopenia is 1 when the most recent 8 am platelet count from Day 0 back to Day -2 is below 100, with missing values left as NA.

  • The variable uses daily_platelet_8a for Days 0, -1 and -2 from the Daily In-Hospital Forms event.
  • The value used is the first non-missing of Day 0, then Day -1, then Day -2.
  • The value is 1 for platelets below 100 and 0 for 100 or above, with units not stated in the code.
  • Missing platelets on all three days returns NA because there is no .default.

Septic Shock

Compare with the systematic version
R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_septic_shock_0.R · 48 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
str_septic_shock_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_septic_shock_0(data, dictionary)
Key assumptions

Septic shock is 1 when the sepsis indicator is 1 and the Day 0 none vasopressor box is unchecked, with every other case defaulting to 0.

  • Sepsis comes from wrapper_calc_sys_sepsis_0, which is 1 if Day 0 antibiotics were Administered, a qualifying antiviral or antifungal was given, or a qualifying pathogen dated on or before enrollment exists.
  • Shock is inferred only from daily_vasopressors_0___0 (none) being Unchecked, so any agent counts, including dobutamine, milrinone and Other.
  • No MAP, lactate or dose threshold is applied.
  • The .default of 0 codes missing sepsis or missing vasopressor data as 0.
  • Qualifying pathogens require cxpos code 3 and resp_pathogen codes 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8 or 17 to 21 from Hospital Discharge and Summary.
Possible issues to confirm
  • Shock is defined by the absence of the none checkbox rather than a checked vasopressor, so a blank vasopressor section exported as Unchecked would count as shock.
  • Antibiotics administered on Day 0 alone is enough to meet the sepsis criterion.
  • Missing data on either component is silently coded 0, and the sepsis header value of 99 is never produced because calc_sys_sepsis_0 also defaults to 0.

Steroid Responsive Comorbidity

Compare with the systematic version
R/steroid-dag-variables/calc_str_steroid_comorb_0.R · 85 lines
Latest on mainPermalink 6ea8edbEdit fileHistory
Output columns
str_steroid_comorb_0
Call
wrapper_calc_str_steroid_comorb_0(data)
Key assumptions

Steroid-responsive comorbidity is 1 only when a rheumatologic condition is checked and the patient has immunosuppression option 4 or chronic steroids (mhccster).

  • The variable uses mhrheumd, m_rheum_conditions options 1 to 7 and 88, m_immunosuppression, m_immunosup_conditions___4 and mhccster from the Day 0 event.
  • The 0 rule is evaluated first and fires if mhrheumd is No with all listed rheum boxes unchecked, or if there is no option 4 treatment and mhccster is No.
  • The value is 1 when mhrheumd is Yes with any listed rheum box checked, and either m_immunosuppression is Yes with option 4 checked or mhccster is Yes.
  • The value is 99 when any of mhrheumd, m_immunosuppression or mhccster is Unknown, but only after the 0 and 1 rules fail.
  • Combinations not covered return NA because there is no .default.
Possible issues to confirm
  • Rheum checkbox option 8, which calc_str_vasculitis_0 uses for vasculitis, is not in the list, so vasculitis alone does not count here.
  • mhrheumd equal to Yes with all listed boxes unchecked and some treatment present matches no rule and returns NA unless a field is Unknown.
  • Because the 0 rule runs first, an Unknown mhrheumd is coded 0 when the patient has no option 4 treatment and mhccster is No.

102 gcs_m1 <- as.character(daily_gcs_8a_m1)
103 gcs_m2 <- as.character(daily_gcs_8a_m2)
104
105 # Treat 'not documented' as NA for all time points
106 gcs_0 <- ifelse(gcs_0 == 'not documented', NA, gcs_0)
107 gcs_m1 <- ifelse(gcs_m1 == 'not documented', NA, gcs_m1)
108 gcs_m2 <- ifelse(gcs_m2 == 'not documented', NA, gcs_m2)
109
110 # Look back to find the last available value without a T
111 gcs <- dplyr::case_when(
112 !is.na(gcs_0) & !grepl('T', gcs_0, fixed = TRUE) ~ gcs_0,
113 !is.na(gcs_m1) & !grepl('T', gcs_m1, fixed = TRUE) ~ gcs_m1,
114 !is.na(gcs_m2) & !grepl('T', gcs_m2, fixed = TRUE) ~ gcs_m2,
115 .default = "15" # Default to normal GCS if no value without T is found
116 )
117
118 return(gcs)
119}

305calc_sofa_2_resp <- function(pf_ratio, sf_ratio, resp_low_pao2, resp_low_spo2, low_spo2) {
306
307 ## if P/F available, use that and corresponding respiratory support value
308 pf_available <- !is.na(pf_ratio)
309 resp_low <- if_else(pf_available, resp_low_pao2, resp_low_spo2)
310
311 ## ECMO
312 ecmo <- grepl('^ECMO', resp_low)
313
314 ## advanced ventilatory support
315 adv_vent <- case_when(
316 resp_low %in% c(
317 'ECMO and invasive mechanical ventilation',
318 'Invasive mechanical ventilation without ECMO',
319 'Non-invasive ventilation',
320 'High-flow nasal oxygen (high flow nasal oxygen)') ~ TRUE,
321 resp_low %in% c(
322 'ECMO without invasive mechanical ventilation',
323 'Standard flow supplemental oxygen',
324 'No respiratory support or supplemental oxygen (spontaneously breathing room air)') ~ FALSE,
325 TRUE ~ NA)
326
327 case_when(
328 # ## any ECMO
329 # ecmo ~ 4,
330
331 ## P/F criteria
332 ( pf_available & pf_ratio <= 75 ) & (is.na(adv_vent) | adv_vent) ~ 4,
333 ( pf_available & pf_ratio <= 150) & (is.na(adv_vent) | adv_vent) ~ 3,
334 ( pf_available & pf_ratio <= 225) ~ 2,
335 ( pf_available & pf_ratio <= 300) ~ 1,
336 ( pf_available & pf_ratio > 300) ~ 0,
337
338 ## S/F criteria
339 (!pf_available & sf_ratio <= 120) & (is.na(adv_vent) | adv_vent) ~ 4,
340 (!pf_available & sf_ratio <= 200) & (is.na(adv_vent) | adv_vent) ~ 3,
341 (!pf_available & sf_ratio <= 249) ~ 2,
342 (!pf_available & sf_ratio <= 300) ~ 1,
343 (!pf_available & sf_ratio > 300) ~ 0,
344
345 ## if not on ECMO and SpO2 > 97, score 0
346 !ecmo & low_spo2 > 97 ~ 0,
347
348 ## not enough information
349 TRUE ~ NA
350 )
351}

397calc_sofa_2_card <- function(sbp, dbp, dopa_mcg, dopa_mcgkg, dobu_mcg, dobu_mcgkg,
398 epin_mcg, epin_mcgkg, nore_mcg, nore_mcgkg,
399 phen_mcg, phen_mcgkg, vaso_dose,ang2_mcg, ang2_mcgkg,
400 weight_kg, resp_supp) {
401
402 ## calculate MAP
403 map <- 1/3*sbp + 2/3*dbp
404
405 ## convert to mcg/kg/min
406 dopa_mcgkg <- ifelse(!is.na(dopa_mcgkg), dopa_mcgkg, dopa_mcg/weight_kg)
407 dobu_mcgkg <- ifelse(!is.na(dobu_mcgkg), dobu_mcgkg, dobu_mcg/weight_kg)
408 epin_mcgkg <- ifelse(!is.na(epin_mcgkg), epin_mcgkg, epin_mcg/weight_kg)
409 nore_mcgkg <- ifelse(!is.na(nore_mcgkg), nore_mcgkg, nore_mcg/weight_kg)
410 phen_mcgkg <- ifelse(!is.na(phen_mcgkg), phen_mcgkg, phen_mcg/weight_kg)
411 ang2_mcgkg <- ifelse(!is.na(ang2_mcgkg), ang2_mcgkg, ang2_mcg/weight_kg)
412
413 ## if missing infusion rate, set equal to zero
414 dopa_mcgkg <- ifelse(!is.na(dopa_mcgkg), dopa_mcgkg, 0)
415 dobu_mcgkg <- ifelse(!is.na(dobu_mcgkg), dobu_mcgkg, 0)
416 epin_mcgkg <- ifelse(!is.na(epin_mcgkg), epin_mcgkg, 0)
417 nore_mcgkg <- ifelse(!is.na(nore_mcgkg), nore_mcgkg, 0)
418 phen_mcgkg <- ifelse(!is.na(phen_mcgkg), phen_mcgkg, 0)
419 ang2_mcgkg <- ifelse(!is.na(ang2_mcgkg), ang2_mcgkg, 0)
420 vaso_dose <- ifelse(!is.na(vaso_dose), vaso_dose, 0)
421
422 ## is dopamine the only vasopressor used?
423 dopa_only <-
424 dopa_mcgkg > 0 &
425 dobu_mcgkg == 0 &
426 epin_mcgkg == 0 &
427 nore_mcgkg == 0 &
428 phen_mcgkg == 0 &
429 ang2_mcgkg == 0 &
430 vaso_dose == 0
431
432 ecmo <- grepl('^ECMO', resp_supp)
433
434 ## calculate cardiovascular component
435 case_when(
436 ecmo ~ 4,
437 epin_mcgkg + nore_mcgkg > 0.4 |
438 ((epin_mcgkg + nore_mcgkg > 0.2) &
439 (dopa_mcgkg > 0.0 |
440 dobu_mcgkg > 0.0 |
441 phen_mcgkg > 0.0 |
442 vaso_dose > 0.0 |
443 ang2_mcgkg > 0.0)) |
444 (dopa_only & dopa_mcgkg > 40) ~ 4,
445 epin_mcgkg + nore_mcgkg > 0.2 |
446 ((epin_mcgkg + nore_mcgkg > 0) &
447 (dopa_mcgkg > 0.0 |
448 dobu_mcgkg > 0.0 |
449 phen_mcgkg > 0.0 |
450 vaso_dose > 0.0 |
451 ang2_mcgkg > 0.0)) |
452 (dopa_only & dopa_mcgkg > 20) ~ 3,
453 epin_mcgkg + nore_mcgkg > 0.0 |
454 dopa_mcgkg > 0.0 |
455 dobu_mcgkg > 0.0 |
456 phen_mcgkg > 0.0 |
457 vaso_dose > 0.0 |
458 ang2_mcgkg > 0.0 ~ 2,
459 map < 70 ~ 1,
460 map >= 70 ~ 0,
461 TRUE ~ NA
462 )
463}

support_functions.R · L511–529

511locf <- function(x) {
512
513 ## return if length == 0
514 if(!length(x))
515 stop('length zero "x"')
516
517 ## no imputation if all missing
518 na <- is.na(x)
519 if (all(na))
520 return(x)
521
522 ## fill gaps
523 ok <- which(!na)
524 if (is.na(x[1L]))
525 ok <- c(1L, ok)
526 gaps <- diff(c(ok, length(x) + 1L))
527
528 return(rep(x[ok], gaps))
529}

536calc_sofa_2_impute <- function(score, impute_eligible, study_day) {
537
538 ## mark missing values before imputation
539 na <- is.na(score)
540
541 ## find index of first value eligible for imputation
542 idx <- match(TRUE, study_day <= 0 & impute_eligible & is.na(score))
543 if(!is.na(idx))
544 score[idx] <- 0
545
546 ## last observation carry forward
547 score <- locf(score)
548
549 ## mark missing ineligible scores as NA
550 score[!impute_eligible & na] <- NA
551
552 return(score)
553}

577calc_norepi_equivalents <- function(
578 daily_ne_dose_8a_0_mcg,
579 daily_ne_dose_8a_0_mcgkg,
580 daily_epi_dose_8a_0_mcg,
581 daily_epi_dose_8a_0_mcgkg,
582 daily_phen_dose_8a_0_mcg,
583 daily_phen_dos_8a_0_mcgkg,
584 daily_vaso_dose_8a_0,
585 daily_dopa_dose_8a_0_mcg,
586 daily_dopa_dos_8a_0_mcgkg,
587 daily_ang2_8a_0_mcg,
588 daily_ang2_8a_0_mcgkg,
589 m_weight_kg
590) {
591
592 ## Convert all doses to mcg/min using weight if needed
593 ne_dose <- dplyr::coalesce(daily_ne_dose_8a_0_mcg, daily_ne_dose_8a_0_mcgkg * m_weight_kg, 0)
594 epi_dose <- dplyr::coalesce(daily_epi_dose_8a_0_mcg, daily_epi_dose_8a_0_mcgkg * m_weight_kg, 0)
595 phen_dose <- dplyr::coalesce(daily_phen_dose_8a_0_mcg, daily_phen_dos_8a_0_mcgkg * m_weight_kg, 0)
596 dopa_dose <- dplyr::coalesce(daily_dopa_dose_8a_0_mcg, daily_dopa_dos_8a_0_mcgkg * m_weight_kg, 0)
597 ang2_dose <- dplyr::coalesce(daily_ang2_8a_0_mcg, daily_ang2_8a_0_mcgkg * m_weight_kg, 0)
598 vaso_dose <- dplyr::coalesce(daily_vaso_dose_8a_0, 0)
599
600 ## Calculate norepinephrine equivalents
601 ## NE = 1, Epi = 1, Phenylephrine = 10, Vasopressin = 0.04 units = 1 mcg NE equivalent
602 ## Dopamine at high doses ~ 0.01, Angiotensin II ~ 1
603 norepi_equiv <- ne_dose +
604 epi_dose +
605 (phen_dose / 10) +
606 (vaso_dose * 2.5) +
607
608 (dopa_dose / 100) +
609 (ang2_dose * 10)
610
611 return(norepi_equiv)
612}
